stem: In a first-order decomposition, the concentration falls from $0.50$ mol L$^{-1}$ to $0.125$ mol L$^{-1}$ in $40$ min. Find $k$.

verdicts.working: For a first-order reaction, k = ln(C₀/Cₜ)/t = ln(0.50/0.125)/40 = ln(4)/40 ≈ 0.0347 min⁻¹.

working:
$k=\dfrac{2.303}{t}\log\dfrac{[A]_0}{[A]_t}$
$k=\dfrac{2.303}{40}\log\dfrac{0.50}{0.125}$
$k=\dfrac{\ln 4}{40}=0.0347$ min$^{-1}$

Independent check: For a first-order reaction, k = ln(C₀/Cₜ)/t = ln(0.50/0.125)/40 = ln(4)/40 ≈ 0.0347 min⁻¹.
